description: Canonical small-file layout for an individual Spark node.
rules: Every canonical root is a real directory; symbolic-link compatibility paths are forbidden.
The sparkpipe checkout remote is the official sparkpipe/sparkpipe repository.
The Git checkout contains code and configuration only.
Full model archives do not belong on internal root storage.
Rank-local payloads are flat files plus a manifest; topology and encoding belong in the dataset name or manifest.
KV backing lives in kvcache/<model>/<topology>.<format> and has a finite configured capacity.
A complete source model belongs on extnvme or cold storage; srcdata holds only the rank-local layer slice plus common reference files.
When an external disk is attached, extnvme is its exact mount target; otherwise extnvme is an empty real directory.
Legacy paths are reported until their contents are migrated and verified; audit never deletes them.
